title: Extraction of Bacterial DNA Using MagMAX™ CORE Kit on KingFisher™ Flex
author: Leyi Wang
materials: MagMAX™ CORE Nucleic Acid Purification Kit

Select the right script on the instrument or load the script if it was not already in the instrument. Download kit script KingFisher Flex heated script: MagMAX CORE_Flex.bdz at https://www.thermofisher.com/order/catalog/product/A32700#/A32700 , and then use BindIt sofware to transfer this script from a computer to the machine with the connection line. BindIt software can be requested and downloaded at the website https://www.thermofisher.com/us/en/home/global/forms/life-science/download-bindit-software-kingfisher-instruments.html

Laboratory specific variations from protocol Ohio ADDL: use molecular grade water to resuspend the colonies. Illinois VDL, Mississippi VRDL, and Oklahoma ADDL: use PBS to resuspend the colonies. Oklahoma ADDL: uses Dry Garnet 0.7mm beads (component of QiAMP fecal kit) to lyse the colony solution on Qiagen Tissuelyzer II (Cat. No. / ID: 85300) for 90seconds at 30Hz.

steps.title: Prepare Bead/PK mix
steps.instruction: Add 20 μL MagMAX™ CORE Magnetic Beads and 10 μL MagMAX™ CORE Proteinase K for each sample, then add 10 % extra volume to cover overage.

steps.title: Prepare Lysis/Binding mix
steps.instruction: Add 350 μL MagMAX™ CORE Lysis Solution and 350 μL MagMAX™ CORE Binding Solution for each sample, then add 10 % extra volume for overage; invert the tube or bottle at least 10 times to mix.

steps.title: Prepare robot plates
steps.instruction: Add 500 μL MagMAX™ CORE Wash Solution 1 to every well of Wash Plate 1 (deep‑well). Add 500 μL MagMAX™ CORE Wash Solution 2 to every well of Wash Plate 2 (deep‑well). Add 100 μL MagMAX™ CORE Elution Buffer to every well of the Elution Plate. Place a tip comb into a 0.5 mL 96‑well plate (Tip Comb Plate).

steps.title: Resuspend bacterial sample
steps.instruction: Using a 1‑μL loop, transfer a full loop of bacterial material into 200 μL PBS or molecular‑grade water; vortex the tube to mix.

steps.title: Add bead/PK mix to wells
steps.instruction: Invert the Bead/PK tube several times to resuspend the beads, then dispense 30 μL of the mix into each well of a 2.4 mL 96‑deep‑well sample plate.

steps.title: Combine sample with bead/PK
steps.instruction: Add 200 μL of the resuspended sample to each well containing 30 μL Bead/PK mix; shake vigorously on a plate shaker for 2 min at room temperature **or** pipette‑mix then incubate for 2 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Add lysis/binding solution
steps.instruction: Add 700 μL of the prepared Lysis/Binding solution to each sample‑containing well.

steps.title: Load plates onto KingFisher
steps.instruction: When prompted by the KingFisher™ Flex, load the Tip Comb Plate, Wash Plate 1, Wash Plate 2, and Elution Plate into their designated positions.

steps.title: Run extraction protocol
steps.instruction: Press the Start button; the instrument will process the plates and complete the DNA extraction in approximately 20 minutes.
